:::{#exm-linf-function-space}
#### Bounded and unbounded functions

Let $S = (0, 1)$ with the [Lebesgue measure](#def-lebesgue-measure) $\measure$.
The [function](functions.qmd#def-function) $f(s) = s$ has $\norm{f}_\infty = 1 < \infty$,
so $f \in \mathcal{L}^\infty(S, \salg, \measure)$ by @def-linf-function-space.
The function $g(s) = 1/s$ exceeds every $C$ on the [set](sets.qmd#def-set) $(0, 1/C)$ of positive [measure](#def-measure),
so $\norm{g}_\infty = \infty$ and $g \notin \mathcal{L}^\infty(S, \salg, \measure)$.

:::
